name: Nakanoto (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nakanoto town emblem in green, blue and yellow: green, blue and yellow stylised strokes rising from a blue swoosh.
history: Municipal flag of Nakanoto, a town in Ishikawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 2005.

features.role: Nakanoto town emblem — green, blue and yellow stylised strokes rising from a blue swoosh
